description:
Replace a navigation menu's items. This is a REPLACE, not a merge — send the whole list.

Three ways to write an item (they mix freely in one menu):

  1. HAND-AUTHORED — omit `source`. Exactly how menus have always worked.
       {"label": "Pricing", "url": "/pricing"}
       {"label": "Company", "children": [{"label": "About", "url": "/about"}]}

  2. SITE-BOUND — the whole page tree, kept in sync automatically.
       {"label": "Browse", "source": {"kind": "site", "depth": 2}}

  3. FOLDER-BOUND — one folder's published descendants.
       {"label": "Guides", "source": {"kind": "folder", "folder_id": "<uuid>", "depth": 2}}

Why bind instead of hand-authoring: a bound item is expanded server-side on every PUBLIC read,
so publishing, renaming, reordering or archiving a page updates the live menu with no menu edit.
Only PUBLISHED, non-folder descendants are ever emitted — drafts can never leak into a public menu.

Getting a folder_id: call content_list_pages and take the `id` of a row with `is_folder: true`
(create one with content_create_page + is_folder=true). Set which page a folder links to with
content_update_page → index_page_id; leave it unset and the folder links to its first published
child by sort_order. Neither resolvable ⇒ the node renders as a label with no link.

`depth` is 1-3 (default 2) and counts levels BELOW the bound item. Deeper is rejected (422).
content_get_navigation returns bindings un-expanded — round-trip the binding, not its expansion.

items.description: The complete menu (replaces the existing one). Each entry is a NavItem.

badge.description: Small tag next to the label, e.g. 'New', 'Beta'.

children.description: Hand-authored sub-items (recursive NavItem). Leave empty on a bound item — the server fills children in from the page tree on the public read.

source.description: Optional binding that makes this item render from the page tree instead of being hand-authored. Omit for a hand-authored item.

depth.description: Levels to expand below this item, 1-3. Default 2.

folder_id.description: Folder page UUID. REQUIRED when kind='folder' (422 without it).

kind.description: 'site' = the whole page tree. 'folder' = one folder's published descendants.

url.description: Destination. Omit on a bound item — the server resolves the folder's index page. Omit on a pure group header too.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_update_navigation
